related_titles_screened.title: Every spectral subset of the cyclic group of order p squared times q times r tiles, for distinct primes p, q and r
Every spectral subset of a cyclic group of order p^n q for distinct primes p and q tiles that group by translations

independence: Only original Theorem 1.1 is selected in the historical scope of three distinct primes p,q,r; the original statement and full proof are printed unchanged. Ordinary named prerequisites are Coven--Meyerowitz [1, Theorem B1 and (T1)/(T2) sufficiency]; Kiss--Malikiosis--Somlai--Vizer [9, Section 4 Reduction 1, Proposition/Corollary 3.4] under the exact source-stated proper subgroup/quotient hypotheses; positive two-prime coset decomposition as source Lemma 3.4; Shi [13] and Malikiosis--Kolountzakis [12] for the proper cyclic group cases; and Kolountzakis--Matolcsi [5, Theorem 2.1] for cardinality at most five. Full new cube-coset lemma 3.5, modular projection lemma 3.6, both spectrum graph arguments and every main cardinality case are retained. Source projection notation A\_k at 445 versus later subscript notation, the literal unselected cyclic group string at 357, and primed/lambda literals in Case 1 remain intact without a mathematical verdict or source repair. All auxiliary claims are uncounted.
